nabers.name: Malik Nabers
nabers.currentStatus: Rehabbing torn ACL + meniscus. Second cleanup surgery (scar tissue removal) performed ~May 2026. Week 1 availability uncertain — HC Harbaugh says recovery is 'not simple.' Target is training camp.

injuries.title: ACL + Meniscus Tear — Right Knee (Week 4, Sept 28, 2025)
injuries.detail: Tore ACL and meniscus vs. the Chargers. Carted off field, placed on IR. Surgery ~late Oct 2025. Second arthroscopic procedure May 2026 to remove scar tissue (arthrofibrosis). Research: NFL WRs return to play after ACL at 60–69% rate, avg 10.9–13.6 months. WRs who return show significantly decreased targets, receptions, yards, and TDs. Career length shortened by ~1.9 seasons. Combined ACL + meniscus carries added complexity. Subsequent ACL re-injury risk ~25% within 2-3 years.
injuries.source: CBS Sports, Newsweek, Bleacher Report — Orthopedic research: OJSM (2021), Arthroscopy (2021)

injuries.title: Concussion (Week 4, Oct 2024)
injuries.detail: Sustained concussion in Week 4 of rookie season, missed 1 game. Cleared in ~10 days. No prior concussion history at LSU. Research: NFL WRs return at 89% rate same season, missing avg 1.5 games. Same-season repeat risk is 5.3–8.3%. WRs are 70% more likely to report long-term cognitive impairment (Harvard FPHS).
injuries.source: NFL Injury Reports, CBS Sports — Harvard Football Players Health Study

injuries.title: Toe Injury (Late 2024, June 2025)
injuries.detail: Dealt with toe injury Dec 2024 (limited practice). Reappeared during June 2025 OTAs. Toe injuries in speed WRs can linger and affect burst off the line.

injuries.title: Shoulder / Back (Training Camp 2025)
injuries.detail: Landed on shoulder early in 2025 camp. Also minor back issue (~2 weeks Aug 2025). Both precautionary holds, returned to full practice.

collins.name: Nico Collins
collins.currentStatus: Healthy entering 2026. Cleared from final concussion (Jan 2026 playoffs) — participated in Pro Bowl 3 weeks later. Three consecutive 1,000-yard seasons. Primary concern: soft-tissue pattern — hamstring + multiple concussions cost 7 full games and parts of 5 others over past two seasons.

injuries.title: Concussion #2 — Playoff Wild Card vs. Steelers (Jan 2026)
injuries.detail: Second concussion of 2025 season during wild-card win at Pittsburgh. Fell on face after catching slant. Carted off, ruled out. Missed divisional round. Cleared ~3 weeks post-injury. Research: Same-season repeat concussion risk is 5.3–8.3%. Players with multiple concussions miss more time from subsequent ones (median 12 vs 8 days). WRs 70% more likely to report long-term cognitive impairment (Harvard FPHS).
injuries.source: ESPN, NY Post — Neurosurgery (2022); Harvard FPHS

injuries.title: Concussion #1 — Week 7 vs. Seahawks (Oct 2025)
injuries.detail: Head slammed on turf during catch attempt on MNF at Seattle. Missed Week 8 vs. 49ers. Returned Week 9 vs. Broncos, played remainder of regular season without issue.
injuries.source: ESPN, SI Texans Daily, SIC Score

injuries.title: Hamstring Strain — Week 5 vs. Bills (Oct 2024)
injuries.detail: Hamstring strain on 67-yard TD vs. Buffalo. Placed on IR, missed 4 games. Returned Week 11. Still finished 68 rec, 1,006 yds, 7 TD in 12 games. Was re-aggravation of existing issue. Hamstring recurrence rate: 12–33% within first year.

injuries.title: Hamstring (2023 Season)
injuries.detail: Hamstring tightness, did not miss significant time. The 2024 re-aggravation suggests a pattern. Collins' explosive profile — 4.44 40, 6'4" 222 lbs — places significant strain on the hamstring complex.

chase.name: Ja'Marr Chase
chase.currentStatus: Healthy entering 2026. Won the receiving triple crown in 2024 (117 rec, 1,708 yds, 17 TD). No significant injuries in 2025. Durable — 16+ games in 3 of 4 NFL seasons.

injuries.title: Hip Fracture / Labral Tear (Oct 2022)
injuries.detail: Hairline hip fracture during Week 6 vs. Saints, worsened by Week 7. Missed 4 games. Still finished 87 rec, 1,046 yds despite missing time. Full recovery, no recurrence through 2023-2025.

injuries.title: Shoulder AC Joint Sprain (Dec 2023)
injuries.detail: Injured shoulder Week 15 of 2023. Played through it for final games and postseason. AC joint sprains resolve in 2-6 weeks. Did not affect 2024 triple crown season.

nacua.name: Puka Nacua
nacua.currentStatus: Healthy entering 2026. NFL all-time leader in receiving yards per game (95.3). Injury-prone label persists from college (broken foot, ankle issues at BYU) and 2024 PCL. Finished 2025 strong despite ankle/rib injuries.

injuries.title: Low Ankle Sprain — Week 6 vs. Ravens (Oct 2025)
injuries.detail: Left ankle injury during Rams' win over Baltimore. Attempted to return but had no targets after re-entry. Missed Week 7 game in London. Benefited from Week 8 bye. Returned Week 9 vs. Saints.

injuries.title: PCL Injury — Preseason/Week 1 (2024)
injuries.detail: PCL injury in 2024 preseason, aggravated Week 1. Missed Weeks 2-7. Despite missing 6 games, still produced 79 catches, 990 yds, 3 TD. PCL injuries affect cutting ability. The return to elite production is encouraging but the pattern (college foot fracture, ankle injuries, PCL) is a durability concern.

injuries.title: Rib Injury — Week 9 (Nov 2025)
injuries.detail: Rib injury in third quarter vs. Saints. Held out precautionarily with Rams ahead. Scans positive. Returned Week 10 without missing a game.

injuries.title: College Injury History (BYU)
injuries.detail: At BYU: broken foot, ankle injury, another leg injury. Limited college production, contributed to fifth-round draft selection. 2023 was first full healthy season of his career. Persistent lower-body pattern warrants monitoring.

lamb.name: CeeDee Lamb
lamb.currentStatus: Healthy entering 2026. Coming off worst fantasy season since rookie year due to high ankle sprain in 2025. Prior to that, three consecutive 100+ reception seasons.

injuries.title: High Ankle Sprain (2025)
injuries.detail: High ankle sprain during 2025 significantly hampered production. High ankle sprains are more severe than low ankle sprains, typically requiring 6-8 weeks for full recovery. WRs particularly affected — limits push-off explosiveness and route-running crispness. Research: avg 4-week absence, residual effects 2-4 weeks after return.

injuries.title: General Durability (2021-2024)
injuries.detail: Prior to 2025 ankle sprain, one of the most durable WRs in football. Played all 17 games in 2023 (135 rec, 1,749 yds, 12 TD) and 2024. Three consecutive 100+ reception seasons.

robinson.name: Bijan Robinson
robinson.currentStatus: Healthy entering 2026. First-team All-Pro in 2025. No significant NFL injuries. Has not missed a game due to injury in his NFL career. Career: 3,910 rush yds, 1,738 rec yds, 34 total TD.

injuries.title: Shoulder Injury — Week 3, 2024
injuries.detail: Appeared on injury report Week 3 2024. Did not miss any games. Workload (304 carries + 61 targets in 2024) puts him at elevated soft-tissue risk going forward.

injuries.title: Elbow Dislocation + Surgery (Nov 2021, Texas)
injuries.detail: Left elbow dislocation at Texas. Required surgery, cleared Feb 2022. No recurrence in NFL.

achane.name: De'Von Achane
achane.currentStatus: Healthy entering 2026. Elite speed (4.32 40, 5'9" 188 lbs) makes him electrifying but raises durability questions. Multiple injuries in first two seasons. When healthy, one of the most explosive backs in the NFL.

injuries.title: Knee Injury (2024)
injuries.detail: Knee injury caused him to miss multiple games in 2024. Per-game production when healthy was elite. Size (5'9" 188 lbs) is both his greatest asset and risk factor. Undersized RBs tend to have shorter career windows but can be highly productive when healthy.

injuries.title: Knee / Concussion (Rookie, 2023)
injuries.detail: Missed time with knee and concussion injuries in rookie year. Despite playing only 11 games, averaged 7.8 ypc — highest in the NFL. Biggest risk is accumulation of smaller ailments limiting availability.

allen.name: Josh Allen
allen.currentStatus: Healthy entering 2026. Rushing style (700+ rush yds multiple seasons) creates elevated risk for a franchise QB. Remarkably durable — 16+ starts every season since 2020.

injuries.title: Elbow Injury (2024)
injuries.detail: Elbow issue monitored during 2024, no missed starts. QB elbow injuries can range from UCL stress to nerve compression. Allen's throwing mechanics and rushing volume place significant stress on elbow and shoulder.

injuries.title: General Durability Profile
injuries.detail: 100+ regular season starts, no significant missed time. But leads all QBs in rushing attempts since 2018. Mobile QBs who rush 100+ times/season have ~15% higher lower-body injury rate. His 6'5" 237 lb frame provides some protection.

gibbs.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
gibbs.currentStatus: Healthy entering 2026. One of the most durable young RBs — no significant injuries in first two NFL seasons. With Montgomery departed, expected to see larger workload in 2026.

injuries.title: Hamstring Tightness (2024)
injuries.detail: Appeared on injury reports with hamstring tightness in 2024. Did not miss games. 4.36 40-yard dash speed means hamstring issues are a natural risk. Modest rushing volume has kept him fresh.

jefferson.name: Justin Jefferson
jefferson.currentStatus: Healthy entering 2026. Coming off his worst fantasy season as a pro in 2025, partly due to transition to J.J. McCarthy at QB. Hamstring concerns linger — missed 7 games in 2023 and dealt with hamstring strain again in 2025 training camp. Five consecutive 1,000-yard seasons to open career.

injuries.title: Hamstring Strain — Training Camp (July 2025)
injuries.detail: Left hamstring strain at training camp, missed ~3 weeks of practice and all preseason games. Returned for Week 1. Jefferson himself said he was 'so scared' of re-injury after the 2023 episode. Research: Hamstring recurrence rate for WRs is 12–33% within first year. Jefferson's explosive profile (4.43 40) and the fact this is the same muscle group as 2023 makes this a season-long monitoring point.
injuries.source: Yahoo Sports, Newsweek, Vikings.com, CBS Sports

injuries.title: Hamstring — Missed 7 Games (2023)
injuries.detail: Right hamstring injury in 2023, first significant injury of NFL career. Missed 7 games. Jefferson was visibly emotional about missing time, calling it the hardest thing he'd been through. Despite missing time, still finished with 68 rec, 1,074 yds, 5 TD in 10 games — showing his per-game ceiling remained elite.

injuries.title: Quad Contusion — Week 2 vs. 49ers (Sept 2024)
injuries.detail: Quad contusion from leg-to-leg contact with Fred Warner. Downplayed severity postgame, did not miss any games. Played all 17 games in 2024: 103 rec, 1,533 yds, 10 TD.

cmc.name: Christian McCaffrey
cmc.currentStatus: Healthy entering 2026 per Kyle Shanahan. Claims 'zero restrictions.' But approaching age 30 with bilateral Achilles tendonitis and PCL tear in 2024 — played only 4 games. Calf scare in 2025 preseason raised alarms but he played through it. Elite talent when healthy but durability is the defining question.

injuries.title: PCL Tear — Week 13 vs. Bills (Dec 2024)
injuries.detail: Attempted to hurdle a defender and landed awkwardly, tearing the PCL in his right knee. Placed on IR, ending his season. Only appeared in 4 games total in 2024: 50 carries, 202 rush yds, 15 rec, 146 rec yds, 0 TD. PCL tears are less common than ACL but affect deceleration and cutting. McCaffrey said the knee healed 'pretty quickly' by early 2025 offseason.
injuries.source: ESPN, CBS Sports, Yahoo Sports, Sportskeeda

injuries.title: Bilateral Achilles Tendonitis (2024 Preseason — Week 9)
injuries.detail: Initially listed as 'calf injury' in training camp, later clarified as bilateral Achilles tendonitis — both legs. Surprise inactive for Week 1 vs. Jets, placed on IR. Traveled to Germany for specialist treatment. Missed 8 games. When he returned Week 10 vs. Tampa Bay, he averaged only 4.0 ypc with a max speed of 17.4 mph — well below his pre-injury 20+ mph. This is an overuse injury that can recur at any time, especially concerning for a RB approaching 30. SI All49ers notes: 'You never bounce back fully from bilateral Achilles tendonitis.'
injuries.source: ESPN, NBC Sports Bay Area, SI All49ers — Research: Achilles tendonitis is chronic/overuse, not a one-time tear

injuries.title: Calf Strain — Training Camp (2025)
injuries.detail: Appeared on injury report with calf issue days into 2025 training camp. Alarming because 2024 Achilles tendonitis was initially listed as a 'calf injury.' Fortunately, McCaffrey shook it off and did not miss regular season time. But the calf/Achilles connection will be a worry every time he reports calf tightness.

injuries.title: Calf Strain — Week 17, 2023
injuries.detail: Mild calf strain vs. Washington in Week 17 of 2023 Offensive Player of the Year season. This may have been the precursor to the 2024 bilateral Achilles issue.

injuries.title: Hamstring Strain / Ankle Sprain (Carolina, 2021)
injuries.detail: Grade 2 hamstring strain Week 3 vs. Texans (missed 5 games). Grade 2 left ankle sprain Week 12 vs. Dolphins (placed on IR, season over). McCaffrey's career has been defined by the 'All-Pro or injured' dichotomy since his Panthers days.
